[SWS_Com_00872] Upstream requirements: SRS_GTW_06055, SRS_GTW_06089 The Signal Gateway shall support the following I-PDU / signal-processing stages on the receiver side: 1. reset reception deadline monitoring timer for I-PDU based monitoring 2. I-PDU callout 3. check of update-bits 4. endianness conversion and sign extension
